rationale: All 8 prior blocking findings graded resolved from current source and the fix-up diff. CR-001 and CR-008 are resolved by new untracked test files (not in changed_files), so confidence is medium; commit them with the fix-up.

findings.title: Assistant rollback endpoint report untested
findings.problem: No test invokes the assistant rollback handler; the wiring of the disabled MCP report into DisabledMcpResponse is unverified (service test checks only the tuple, OpenAPI baseline only schema shape).
findings.impact: If the handler dropped the report, the public API would silently stop reporting disabled MCP links on assistant rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add a router-level test calling rollback_assistant_version with AssistantVersionService.rollback_to_version mocked to return (config, [DisabledMcpServer(...)]) and assert result.disabled_mcp_servers equals the report.
findings.check_notes: New router test test_rollback_returns_disabled_mcp_report asserts disabled_mcp_servers; file is untracked, not in changed_files

fix.change: Added router-level test for assistant rollback report passthrough

findings.title: Editor confirms only known top-level keys
findings.problem: _confirmed compares only the hard-coded _KNOWN_KEYS; other or future top-level keys are never verified unchanged, and _copy_without_mcp strips mcp_servers/mcp_server keys at any depth. Reachability not fully confirmed.
findings.impact: Edit side effects on unlisted keys go unverified despite the 'only reported nodes changed' claim; reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Compare all top-level keys, not only _KNOWN_KEYS, in _confirmed.
findings.check_notes: _confirmed now compares the union of all top-level keys; _KNOWN_KEYS removed

fix.change: _confirmed now compares the union of all top-level keys; _KNOWN_KEYS removed

findings.title: Post-edit hook lacks single return point
findings.problem: disable_dead_links_in_yaml has several return paths; the EPMCDME-16640 seam is a separate no-op after_workflow_links_changed invoked by callers after save, whereas spec requires one return point inside the named function.
findings.impact: Required spec design constraint only partly met; 16640 sync may be bypassed or misfire on rollbacks with no link changes.
findings.recommendation: Restructure disable_dead_links_in_yaml to end in a single return point where EPMCDME-16640 adds its sync, per spec.
findings.check_notes: disable_dead_links_in_yaml has one return; AST test added

fix.change: disable_dead_links_in_yaml has one return point; edit logic moved to _disable_reported

findings.title: Catalogue outage on workflow rollback unhandled
findings.problem: Non-strict restore_mcp_servers re-raises catalogue read errors; rollback_to_version maps only WorkflowYamlEditError.
findings.impact: A DB or catalogue outage during rollback surfaces as an unhandled 500; previously rollback without dead links did not read the catalogue. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Catch lookup errors and raise a controlled ExtendedHTTPException (e.g. 503) from the cause.
findings.check_notes: Catalogue errors mapped to ExtendedHTTPException 503; test added

fix.change: Workflow rollback maps catalogue read errors to a 503 ExtendedHTTPException

findings.title: Partial catalogue miss skips disabling in seeded workflows
findings.problem: disable_unavailable_mcp_links uses strict_lookup=True, which raises CatalogLookupError when any linked id has no row, so one missing config among several leaves the template fully enabled. Spec says only a lookup exception or an empty result for a non-empty id set skips the helper; partial misses still disable. The test encodes the opposite; the assistants path follows the spec.
findings.impact: Preconfigured workflows are seeded with dead MCP links enabled, violating a required spec behavior; the two preconfigured paths are inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Skip the helper only on lookup exception or no rows at all; on partial misses disable the unavailable links and log. Update test_one_missing_among_several_saved_as_written_and_error_logged.
findings.check_notes: Strict lookup raises only on empty result; partial miss disables; tests updated

fix.change: strict_lookup raises only on lookup failure or no rows; partial misses disable and log

findings.title: Null assistants/tools crash template rebuild
findings.problem: template.assistants/tools are rebuilt by hand via data.get('assistants', []); a null key raises TypeError, and extra or invalid keys raise after yaml_config is already replaced, leaving the template half-updated. Rebuild also duplicates normal YAML-to-model parsing.
findings.impact: Seeding of a preconfigured workflow can abort on an edge-shaped template; reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Use `data.get('assistants') or []` and `data.get('tools') or []`; wrap the rebuild in try/except (TypeError, ValidationError) and fall back to the unedited template.
findings.check_notes: Null keys handled with 'or []'; rebuild wrapped, falls back to unedited template

fix.change: Template rebuild uses 'or []' and falls back to the unedited template on TypeError/ValidationError

findings.title: Workflow agent-node disabled-MCP path untested
findings.problem: Spec asks to confirm workflow agent nodes reach the disabled-server skip with a test; the added test calls MCPToolkitService.get_mcp_server_tools directly and ToolNode only.
findings.impact: Runtime behavior for disabled MCP entries in workflow agent nodes is unproven.
findings.recommendation: Add a test exercising a workflow agent node reaching the disabled-server skip.
findings.check_notes: Test drives VirtualAssistantService agent-node path into the disabled-server skip

fix.change: Added test that a workflow agent node's virtual assistant reaches the disabled-server skip

findings.title: Marketplace moderation unchanged test missing
findings.problem: Spec requires 'marketplace moderation unchanged (verified by test)'; no such test is present in the diff.
findings.impact: Moderation regression would go undetected; required spec criterion only partly met.
findings.recommendation: Add a test verifying marketplace moderation behaviour is unchanged.
findings.check_notes: New test_entity_adapter_mcp_unchanged.py asserts moderation sees disabled and enabled servers; untracked

fix.change: Added test that marketplace moderation reads MCP servers regardless of enabled flag

standards_review.notes: All 9 subjects in range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
New modules carry license headers, use modern type hints; access_control.py under the ~500 line threshold. No documented rule violated in sampled checks
YAML parsing uses safe_load/compose and fails closed on YAMLError; logs contain only server names and config ids, no credentials

final_round.rationale: Blind lens was truncated (partial coverage); acceptance found two spec requirements only partly met (preconfigured partial-miss handling, single post-edit return point). Reachability was verified only for the highest-risk candidates; ~12 candidates dismissed as noise or deliberate spec decisions (e.g. is_link/custom-config predicate deferred to EPMCDME-16490). Nothing deferred.
